q1: SELECT O1.SEAT_ID FROM CINEMA O1 WHERE O1.FREE = 1 AND ((SELECT FREE FROM CINEMA O2 WHERE O2.SEAT_ID = O1.SEAT_ID - 1) = 1 OR (SELECT FREE FROM CINEMA O2 WHERE O2.SEAT_ID = O1.SEAT_ID + 1) = 1)
q2: SELECT DISTINCT(A.SEAT_ID) FROM CINEMA A JOIN CINEMA B ON ABS(A.SEAT_ID - B.SEAT_ID) = 1 WHERE A.FREE = 1 AND B.FREE = 1 ORDER BY A.SEAT_ID

counterexample: INSERT INTO CINEMA (SEAT_ID, FREE) VALUES (1, TRUE), (2, TRUE), (3, TRUE), (4, FALSE), (5, TRUE);
explanation: Q1 and Q2 are not equivalent. Q1 checks for seats that are free and have at least one adjacent seat that is also free, while Q2 finds pairs of adjacent free seats.
counterexample_dsp: Q1 will return a seat if it is free and at least one of its adjacent seats is also free. Q2 will return a seat if it is part of a pair of adjacent free seats.
